'''Gamden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked in the employ of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gamden appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Hutta Commendations Vendor on Carrick Station, though he was later relabeled as a Level 8 Equipment Vendor.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> he was removed from the game along with the rest of the Equipment Commendations Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
